title.en: Write a clear request or complaint
title.es: Redactar una petición o reclamo claro

es: Redactar un correo de reclamo a un servicio técnico que no respondió antes: referencia, problema, petición con plazo, consecuencia y cierre, con firmeza y cortesía.

teaching.en: I am writing again because I have not received a reply to my previous email.
teaching.es: Escribo de nuevo porque no he recibido respuesta a mi correo anterior.
teaching.explanationEs: Previous email recuerda el primer mensaje: es la referencia del segundo correo.

teaching.en: This delay is unacceptable, as the heater has been broken for three weeks.

choices.text: I am writing to say hello again.

I never wrote to you before.

feedback.es: Regarding my previous message da la referencia: recuerda el primer mensaje sin respuesta; las otras opciones no lo mencionan.

hint.es: Empieza por recordar el mensaje anterior.

prompt.es: Escribe el correo: problema, petición con plazo, consecuencia y cierre.

answer.text: Dear Ms Gil, I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, which has not received a reply. The heating in my flat has not worked for three weeks. The flat is cold, and I have two young children, so this situation is very difficult for my family. I apologise for any inconvenience to you, but I am afraid this delay is unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could send an engineer by Friday 12 June, and I would like to have the heater repaired on the same visit. Please confirm the date of the visit promptly by email or by phone. I have attached a copy of my previous email so that you can see the details. Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager. I trust that we can resolve this matter quickly. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Leo Vega

Please confirm the date of the visit promptly by email or by phone. I have attached a copy of my previous email so that you can see the details. Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager. I trust that we can resolve this matter quickly. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Leo Vega

Dear Ms Gil, I wrote to you on 2 June about the heating in my flat, but I have not had an answer. The heater has been broken for three weeks, and my two children are cold every night. I understand that you are busy, but I must remain firm: this situation is unacceptable. Could you kindly send an engineer before Friday 12 June? We are using two small electric heaters, and our electricity bill is already higher. I would also like to have the heater repaired during that visit, so that I do not need to ask again. Please confirm the date promptly. Failing that, I will make a formal complaint, and I will escalate the matter to your manager. I trust that you will resolve this quickly, and I would appreciate a short reply today. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Leo Vega

feedback.es: Un buen reclamo recuerda el correo anterior, describe el problema con hechos, pide una acción con plazo, anuncia la consecuencia con cortesía y cierra con confianza en una respuesta.

origin.text: Hace tres semanas se estropeó la calefacción de tu piso. Escribiste a la empresa HomeFix el 2 de junio y nadie respondió. Escribe en inglés un correo de 190 a 240 palabras a la Sra. Gil, de atención al cliente: recuerda tu correo anterior, describe el problema con un hecho y una fecha (tienes dos niños pequeños), pide un técnico antes del viernes 12 de junio, anuncia con cortesía una queja formal si no responden y cierra confiando en una respuesta pronta.

prompt.es: Elige la frase firme pero cortés para fijar un plazo.

choices.text: I would be grateful if you could resolve this by Friday.
Resolve this by Friday or you will regret it.
Maybe you could resolve this one day.

feedback.es: La primera fija el plazo con cortesía; la segunda amenaza y la tercera no da ninguna fecha.
I apologise for any inconvenience es la disculpa estándar que suaviza una petición firme.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace el cliente en este mensaje.

choices.text: He thanks the shop for repairing the screen.
He sets a deadline and warns that he will ask for a refund.
He asks for a cheaper laptop.

feedback.es: El cliente fija un plazo (Monday) y avisa de que pedirá un reembolso completo si no hay respuesta.

origin.audio: This is my third message about the broken laptop screen. If I do not get a reply by Monday, I will ask for a full refund.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase describe el problema con un hecho y una fecha?

choices.text: The printer has not worked since 3 May.

feedback.es: Un buen reclamo da hechos comprobables con una fecha; las otras opciones son opinión o reproche.

origin.text: Quieres describir un fallo de impresora con datos, no con quejas generales.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pide la clienta tras la disculpa.

choices.text: She asks for the part by Friday.
She accepts the delay without a problem.
She asks the company to call next month.

feedback.es: Tras la disculpa, la clienta mantiene la petición: la pieza debe llegar antes del viernes.
